item.description: 2026世界人工智能大会在上海隆重举行，昇腾以“与时代 共昇腾”为主题亮相世博展览馆，围绕超节点架构创新、规模商用实践、开源生态建设三大核心维度，呈现Agentic AI时代算力基础设施的完整解决方案。从旗舰级的Atlas 950 SuperPoD到普惠型Atlas 850E风冷超节点，从CANN开源到千行百业的规模化落地，昇腾以根技术能力与开放兼容的生态策略，为智能时代的算力基础设施建设提供全新路径。

item.description: 近日，在2026世界人工智能大会期间举办的“中兴通讯全栈智算生态论坛”上，中兴通讯正式发布OEX超节点新品。中兴通讯股份有限公司执行副总裁、首席运营官谢峻石，上海仪电（集团）有限公司副总裁刘山泉，沐曦集成电路（上海）股份有限公司联合创始人、CTO兼首席软件架构师杨建，上海壁仞科技股份有限公司战略规划高级副总裁魏明，上海曦智科技股份有限公司联合创始人、CTO孟怀宇，上海燧原科技股份有限公司产品与系统研发高级副总裁陈松涛，上海天数智芯半导体股份有限公司副总裁宋煜，共同莅临见证。

item.title: Cold-atom comagnetometry via optical control of spin states
item.description: Nature Photonics, Published online: 17 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-01982-4 A cold-atom comagnetometer based on the nuclear spins of 171Yb and 173Yb is demonstrated. A spin coherence time of 60 s is achieved for both isotopes. The 171Yb–173Yb ratio of nuclear magnetic moments is determined as –0.726076(3) with a 4-ppm precision.

Quantum light engine links atom-photon thermodynamics to classical physics
item.description: What is heat, and what is useful work if a machine consists only of an atom and light particles? In modern quantum technologies, this kind of question connects thermodynamics with quantum physics. Researchers at the University of Basel, Switzerland, have developed a theoretical approach that can reconcile both theories.

item.title: Physicists predict a new form of quantum matter that holds itself together
item.description: Researchers at Monash University have predicted a new type of quantum matter that challenges decades of thinking about how ultracold particles behave. The paper, "Quantum droplets in a resonant Bose-Fermi mixture," is published in Physical Review Letters.

item.title: Anomalous quantum oscillations reveal new physics in a topological insulator
item.description: A study has been published in Nature Communications that identifies an unusual regime of quantum oscillations in a three-dimensional topological insulator. The results show that, when subjected to temperatures near absolute zero and extreme magnetic fields, electrons in the material zirconium pentatelluride (ZrTe₅) exhibit behavior that deviates from the pattern predicted by conventional theory.

item.title: Nonrepeating photonic crystal may enable more tunable, reliable semiconductor lasers
item.description: Over the past two decades, photonic-crystal surface-emitting lasers (PCSELs) have shown promise as a type of advanced semiconductor laser useful in defense- and aerospace-related applications. Typically, these devices are made with photonic crystal patterns that repeat across the area of the device. But new research from the lab of electrical and computer engineering professor Kent Choquette has demonstrated a quasi-periodic photonic-crystal surface-emitting laser (QPCSEL). item.title: Bound gravitational waves inspired by photonic systems
item.description: When one mentions "waves," we immediately think of a perturbation that propagates. This applies to waves on the shore, sound waves in the air or electromagnetic waves that we use to transmit information via optical fibers. The same idea of propagating perturbations applies to gravitational waves (GWs), which entered the mainstream media a decade ago after their first direct detection. These are perturbations of the elastic fabric that we are all embedded in, called spacetime.

item.title: Quantum advantage reassessed: More realistic benchmarks for quantum algorithms
item.description: Quantum advantage refers to the point at which a quantum computer solves a clearly defined task faster or more efficiently than any classical computer—or makes it solvable in the first place. For many practical applications, this has not yet been demonstrated. Research therefore relies heavily on theoretical models and simulations to explore where and under what conditions such an advantage may realistically be achieved in the future.

item.title: New optical method reveals internal dynamics of elusive Wigner crystals
item.description: Researchers at the University of Basel and the Technical University of Munich have developed a new method to reveal the collective motion of electrons in one of the most elusive states of matter: the Wigner crystal. Using light, the physicists were able to uncover previously inaccessible properties of this fragile quantum state.

item.title: Breaking the power wall in programmable photonics
item.description: Nature Photonics, Published online: 31 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-01960-w A non-volatile photonic gate array based on ferroelectric domain switching eliminates static power consumption, pointing towards scalable and energy-efficient photonic integrated circuits.

item.title: 大招齐发，英特尔直击网络转型
item.description: 运营商是实现5G连接及应用和业务创新的重要基石，也是网络转型的主角。作为中国三大运营商之一的中国电信，正在努力推进网络转型，为5G的到来做好准备。中国电信选择与英特尔合作，采用英特尔RSD实施方案，联手击破运营商在网络转型中的各个难题，真正做到在网络转型之路所向披靡。

item.title: 对话英特尔：产业协作与标准化助推5G成功
item.description: 5G不仅仅是为了手机而设计的，更多的是用于未来的智慧城市、智能家居以及VR等场景。在这个过程中，英特尔和产业合作伙伴也需要不断地学习，从测试当中不断地学习和调整技术和解决方案。英特尔扮演着独特的贡献的角色，通过前期测试当中不断吸取经验和教训，来反馈到标准化的制定当中，让更多的产业合作伙伴受益。

item.title: 英特尔助力电信网络转型 让5G不再是“看上去很美”
item.description: 实现5G愿景，可并不仅仅是从基站到手机终端那点事。对无线技术进行革新，只是5G万里长征中的一段路。虽然对于普通消费者而言，这是他们未来能够从手机端看到的变革，但更多他们看不到的变化——电信运营商网络的转型。

item.title: 两会关注：提速降费步伐加快，三大运营商打出全新组合拳
item.description: 年两会总理提出了2017年“网络提速降费要迈出更大步伐”，并明确了三个方向：年内全部取消手机国内长途和漫游费；大幅降低中小企业互联网专线接入资费；降低国际长途电话费。为了响应政府号召，三大运营商都公布了2017年提速降费的新政，通过一些列组合拳持续推进提速降费。

item.title: 中国电信六大新举措持续推进提速降费
item.description: 今天上午，国务院新闻办公室举办国务院政策吹风会。根据会议的内容显示，2017年10月1日起，三大运营商将全部取消手机国内长途和漫游费。此外，运营商还需要进一步提速降费。作为三大运营商之一的中国电信响应国家号召，2017年中国电信推出六大新举措，持续推进提速降费。

item.title: MWC 2017之无线篇：设备商5G竞赛正式打响
item.description: 在近日于西班牙巴塞罗那举行2017世界移动大会(Mobile World Congress，MWC 2017)上，5G无疑是本次展会的最大亮点之一。在此期间，各5G研发组织、运营商、设备商、学术界以及合作伙伴等产业链各方在5G研发方面的最新进展备受业界关注。其中，移动通信设备商纷纷选择在大会期间发布重磅新品和解决方案，以期在5G竞赛中占得先机。
